description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated.

description.zh:
延迟报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
>-  本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
- 国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持[通过云监控平台为DTS任务设置报警规则](~~175876~~)。
description.en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for latency alerts. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).
>- This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com). Only Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers are supported, and you can specify up to 10 mobile phone numbers.
- China site (Chinese mainland) does not support Chinese mainland mobile phone alerts. You can only [configure alert rules for DTS tasks in CloudMonitor](~~175876~~).

description.zh:
是否监控延迟状态，取值：

- **enable**：是。
- **disable**：否。

> - 默认取值为**enable**。
- 本参数和**ErrorAlertStatus**参数两者中至少传入一个。
description.en:
Specifies whether to monitor the latency status. Valid values:

- **enable**: yes.
- **disable**: no.

> - Default value: **enable**.
- You must specify at least one of this parameter and the **ErrorAlertStatus** parameter.

description.zh:
触发延迟报警的阈值，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。
> 当**DelayAlertStatus**取值为**enable**时，本参数必须传入。
description.en:
The threshold for triggering a latency alert. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer. Set the threshold based on your business requirements. To avoid alert fluctuations caused by network issues or database loads, set the threshold to 10 seconds or more.
> This parameter is required when **DelayAlertStatus** is set to **enable**.

description.zh:
异常报警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
>-  本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持大陆手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
- 国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持[通过云监控平台为DTS任务设置报警规则](~~175876~~)。
description.en:
The mobile phone numbers of contacts for exception alerts. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).
>- This parameter is supported only on the China site (aliyun.com). Only Chinese mainland mobile phone numbers are supported, and you can specify up to 10 mobile phone numbers.
- China site (Chinese mainland) does not support Chinese mainland mobile phone alerts. You can only [configure alert rules for DTS tasks in CloudMonitor](~~175876~~).

description.zh:
是否监控异常状态，取值：

- **enable**：是。
- **disable**：否。

> - 默认取值为**enable**。
- 本参数和**DelayAlertStatus**参数两者中至少传入一个。
- 开启监控异常状态功能后，如果检测到异常，将触发报警。
description.en:
Specifies whether to monitor the exception status. Valid values:

- **enable**: yes.
- **disable**: no.

> - Default value: **enable**.
- You must specify at least one of this parameter and the **DelayAlertStatus** parameter.
- After you enable exception status monitoring, an alert is triggered when an exception is detected.

description.zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSubscriptionInstances接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID.

title.zh: 配置订阅通道的监控报警
title.en: Configure monitoring and alerting for a change tracking channel

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts configure-subscription-instance-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsl8zl9ek62920000 --delay-alert-status enable --delay-alert-phone 13612340000,13712340000 --error-alert-status enable --error-alert-phone 13612340000,13712340000 --delay-over-seconds 10 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ConfigureSubscriptionInstanceAlert --region cn-hangzhou --ErrorAlertPhone '13612340000,13712340000' --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --DelayAlertPhone '13612340000,13712340000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ErrorAlertStatus enable --SubscriptionInstanceId dtsl8zl9ek62920000 --DelayAlertStatus enable --DelayOverSeconds 10
